changeSet.author: uuid-migration
changeSet.comment: Align bans, user_photos, user_roles, and user_push_tokens with Kotlin entities.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE bans DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS banned_at;
ALTER TABLE bans DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS expires_at;
ALTER TABLE bans ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS banned_until TIMESTAMP;
ALTER TABLE bans ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS permanent BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE;
ALTER TABLE bans ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW();
ALTER TABLE user_photos ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS photo_bytes BYTEA;
ALTER TABLE user_photos ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW();
ALTER TABLE user_roles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW();
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_user_push_tokens_token ON user_push_tokens(token);
